children: Cal-Maine Foods entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement establishing a senior unsecured $250 million revolving credit facility to support working capital, capital expenditures, acquisitions, and general corporate purposes. The facility includes $25 million sublimits each for letters of credit and swingline loans, plus an accordion to increase capacity by up to $250 million. It matures on August 31, 2031, with borrowings accruing interest at Term SOFR or Base Rate plus an applicable margin. As of September 1, 2026, no amounts were drawn and $5.9 million of standby letters of credit were outstanding.
: Senior unsecured five-year revolving credit facility with accordion
: BMO Bank, as Administrative Agent, and other lenders
: Enhance liquidity for working capital, capex, and acquisitions
